author: Mark Manson
description:
Luck is the one part of your life you're most likely to treat as fixed. It works more like poker: the cards you're dealt are only the first layer, and the table you choose and how you play the hand are both far more open to you. Drew and I get into all three with Annie Duke. 

Watch the full Solved episode here: https://mrk.mn/luckepisode
title: The 3 Different Types of Luck

Ask most successful people how they got where they are, and the answer is usually some version of "good timing." Everyone else swears they earned it. We're terrible at seeing our own luck clearly, and even worse at realizing how much of it we could create.

In this episode, Drew and I get into why: the psychology that makes us deny luck even exists, and what changes the moment you stop pretending everything is earned. 

We start with Warren Buffett - why a man worth tens of billions says the single most important thing
title: How to Get Lucky, Solved
